name: Sign Out
summary: An authenticated user explicitly ends the current client session and returns to an anonymous authentication state.
finalOutcome: The current client session is terminated, local authentication state is cleared, protected application state is no longer available through that session, and the client returns to the Welcome surface.

sourceReferences.note: Canonical handler revokes the supplied current refresh token when present, terminates the current sign-in session and records UserLogout.
Canonical POST /api/auth/signout delegates authenticated current-session termination to AuthenticationFlowService.
Angular Web consumes the generated createSignout operation and returns to auth.welcome after successful cookie-session termination.
React Native consumes generated createSignout with the stored current refresh token, then clears local auth state and returns to auth.welcome.
Authored proof covers cookie-backed and token-backed current-session termination plus UserLogout audit evidence.

The category is presented as Sign Out while retaining the stable session-management category key. Sign Out is modeled as one atomic action from authenticated host UI to auth.welcome; no confirmation or completion AuthView is required.
